pages.text: $(o)The last dragon, circling the island at the heart of the End.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() The crystals on the pillars heal it. Break them first, then stay out of its purple breath: it eats through any armor.$(br2)It also heals slowly by itself. Once you start, do not stop.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Dragonscale$(), with the Citadel Keystone, raises your world tier to Pinnacle.
